refs.relationship: CalVCB is a statutory implementation of the § 28(b)(13) constitutional restitution right (partial)

refs.target: Pen. Code §§ 679 et seq. (victim rights implementation statutes)
refs.relationship: Implementing legislation for § 28 in the criminal process context
Federal analog to Marsy's Law; applies in federal criminal proceedings
Criminal Law Specialist carries the criminal-process implementation of § 28; Victim Compensation Litigator carries the compensation-process overlay
Federal procedural due process claims (42 USC § 1983) can parallel Marsy's Law violations when state actors fail to honor victim rights
§ 28(c) explicitly makes § 28(b) rights enforceable by the victim in trial or appellate courts
Marsy's Law violations in CalVCB proceedings are reviewable on writ of mandate to superior court
